A '''nutrient dispenser''' was used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] to feed the captives on the [[clustership]] [[Crèche (clustership)|''Crèche'']]. The dispenser had a thick, tapered spout which the captive would place his bowl under. The dispenser would then dispense the allotted amount of [[nutrient]] into the captives bowl. The food was the same for every meal and every captive regardless of [[Species/Legends|species]] and, as the Yuuzhan Vong despised [[Droid/Legends|droids]], was prepared in some way by creatures.<ref name="Jedi Eclipse" />
